_comment: World map variants – the `variant` input of the “Map · Build world” workflow.
One place for what a variant holds: schema layers, catalog name, budget and fonts.
A variant only PICKS layers from `world.yml`; sources nobody reads aren't downloaded.
`basic` has its own region key (`svet_basic`), so it never overwrites the full map.
A schema layer's name in `contents.json` and `maps.json` (`MAP_LAYERS`).
Labels have no name of their own: they belong to a layer already listed.

full.label: full – water, state borders and download regions

basic.label: basic – only state borders and download regions (up to 15 MB)
_comment: No water and no lakes. Labels stay: they name the borders and regions
for a few tens of kB, and without seas only labels give orientation.
